raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The figure displays two line graphs, each plotting the variable BLEU against a different parameter. The left graph shows BLEU values on the y-axis ranging from 28.0 to 28.5, plotted against the parameter α on the x-axis, which ranges from 0.1 to 0.9 with marked intervals at 0.1, 0.3, 0.5, 0.7, and 0.9. The data is represented by a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU value of approximately 28.0 at α = 0.1, increasing to a peak of approximately 28.5 at α = 0.5, and then decreasing to approximately 28.1 at α = 0.9. The right graph plots BLEU values on the same y-axis scale (28.0 to 28.5) against the parameter ρ on the x-axis, which ranges from 0.05 to 0.45 with marked intervals at 0.05, 0.15, 0.25, 0.35, and 0.45. This graph also uses a solid blue line with circular markers, starting at a BLEU value of approximately 28.3 at ρ = 0.05, rising to a peak of approximately 28.5 at ρ = 0.15, then decreasing to approximately 28.4 at ρ = 0.25, increasing again to approximately 28.45 at ρ = 0.35, and finally decreasing slightly to approximately 28.4 at ρ = 0.45.
